items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: The mention of Pilate is in a sermon by Speaker_04, not in the interviewee's response or narrative.

ctx.x: Thank God. Thank God. My mind is gone. That old mind is gone. Oh, glory. I got a brand new mind. I got a mind. Go all the way. I got a new mind. Thank you. Thank you.

Friends, we've been listening to the Prayer Tower Church of God in Christ. And 7734 Olive Street. But we truly believe that just God and one is the majority. And if we can just let the mind of Christ dwell in us richly, then surely, surely, we'll be able to stand up. Not as Pilate did, but stand firm as John did. The disciples have loved you. We hope you'll be listening to us on next Sunday when we shall again bring you. Good stuff. Thank you.
